=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- agents.md:lines 545-550 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: New workflow behavior documentation was added directly to `agents.md` instead of through an `agents.d/` fragment, contrary to CLAUDE.md §30 ("agents.md Fragments (MANDATORY)").
  WHY: CLAUDE.md §30 states "Never add to agents.md (or AGENTS.md) directly. Write a fragment instead." The rule exists because concurrent PRs editing agents.md cause merge conflicts (111 of 149 blocked merge-train pairs per the #7058 changelog). This PR adds new sentences documenting the weekly only-missing schedule, skipped_present status, and presence_list_failed status directly in the agents.md paragraph. No agents.d/ fragment was created. While no CI check fails today, this reintroduces the exact conflict pattern §30 prevents.
- changelog.d/6712-propagate-consumer-secrets-schedule.md:line 4 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The changelog fragment says manual secret setup is needed "only after a failed run or a no-register seed", omitting the status=skipped_empty case that was added to README.md (lines 51-52) and both seed-repo.md copies (steps 6, 8, and checklist item 2).
  WHY: When a library secret is unset, the propagation script logs status=skipped_empty and the run stays green without copying that secret. The README and seed-repo instructions correctly tell operators to add the secret manually in this case, but the changelog fragment — which operators read at release time — omits it. This leaves operators with contradictory guidance: the code and primary docs say three cases need manual setup, but the changelog says only two.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===

=== FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
- changelog.d/6712-propagate-consumer-secrets-schedule.md:line 4 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The fragment's manual-setup trigger list ("asks for manual setup only after a failed run or a `no-register` seed") omits the `status=skipped_empty` case that the rest of this same PR ships.
  WHY: No code failure; the shipped changelog contradicts the behavior the PR itself documents and ships, so operators relying on release notes will not learn that an unset library secret requires manual consumer-side setup.
- agents.md:lines 542-553 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The PR adds new workflow-behaviour documentation by editing `agents.md` directly, while CLAUDE.md §30 (`## §30. agents.md Fragments (MANDATORY)`, CLAUDE.md:1754-1756, merged onto main during this PR) states "Never add to `agents.md` (or `AGENTS.md`) directly. Write a fragment instead" at `agents.d/<issue-or-pr>-<slug>.md`.
  WHY: No CI check fails, but this reintroduces the exact concurrent-edit hunk §30 exists to remove: the touched paragraph sits mid-section in the workflow-architecture narrative that other propagation PRs edit, and changelog #7058 recorded `agents.md` as the dominant merge-train conflict file (111 of 149 blocked pairs).
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: Consistency of the PR's own changelog deliverable with the behaviour the PR ships: the fragment must list all three manual-setup cases (failed run, `status=skipped_empty` for a secret, `no-register` seed), matching README.md:52-53 and both seed-repo.md copies.
  Expected change site: changelog.d/6712-propagate-consumer-secrets-schedule.md line 4
  Evidence of absence: The fragment (verified by direct read) still carries the two-case wording "only after a failed run or a `no-register` seed"; no hunk in the PR or the last-run diff adds `status=skipped_empty` to it, while the README edit in LAST RUN DIFF and the earlier seed-repo edits moved the shipped docs to the three-case wording. Flagged as a consensus item by six reviewer slots across four passes; deferred by editors only because the fragment was sandbox-excluded in their runs.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM z-ai_glm-5_3-flash ===
